title.narrative: Action to improve nutrition, agriculture, gender, economic well-being for women and children under two's transformation.

description.narrative: A total of 25,075 people are to be reached directly by the project. The direct target group is made up as follows:(a)9900 women and girls of reproductive age.(b)9900 men with women of reproductive age.(c)65 employees of the village health department.(d)210 Representatives of the Committee for Coordination and Food.(e)5000 members of village communities reached through media and mass communication.

Impact: The nutritional situation of women and girls of reproductive age and of children under the age of 2 in the Teso sub-region has improved.Outcome:15,000 households with women and girls of reproductive age and children under the age of 2 in the districts of Katakwi and Amuria are sustainably improving their nutritional practices, gender relations and livelihoods.
Nutrition, Agriculture, Gender Equality and Economic Well-being for the Empowerment and Transformation of Women and Young Children in Teso. This is a multi-sectoral project with a nutrition lens.

participating-org.narrative: Germany - Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development
